newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares close at new high, led by forestry.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares close at new high, led by forestry.

text.p: Sweden's stock market rose to a new high on Monday, ignoring weaker bluechip stocks and taking its lead from the forestry sector and cyclicals.
The Stockholm general index rose 0.36 percent to 2167.18 on moderate turnover of about 3.2 billion crowns. The market turned up late in trading as Wall Street opened.
Brokers said the strength in forestry was due to a correction after the recent lacklustre performance by the sector in comparison with other industries.
The forestry sector index rose 0.53 percent. Stora rose three crowns to 86.50 and MoDo was up 3.5 to 182.5 crowns.
Cyclical stocks also posted gains. Sandvik was a top performer, climbing six crowns to 160.
Blue chips finished the day lower. Telecoms giant Ericsson dropped 3.5 crowns to end at 186.5 and drugs major Astra slipped 1.5 to 305.5 crowns.
Brokers said the main focus of the market was the nine-month reports that are starting to come out. ABB and SCA are due to release their reports on Tuesday.
